header.subLine: FD-5 · Week A · 10 of 15 meals · One retailer, one order · 39 lines
header.hint: Everything here comes from one Morrisons order — no second shop, no market run. 5 meals are cut, cleanly, because Morrisons doesn't stock what they need: all of Wednesday (egg sauce, efo riro, pepper soup) and Friday's breakfast (callaloo & egg skillet) need plantain — Morrisons' plantain search turns up only plantain crisps. Wednesday's lunch also needs egusi, which returns zero results. Thursday's lunch needs edamame spaghetti and turkey breast mince — neither is stocked (turkey mince here is thigh, not breast). Everything else survives untouched, at real Morrisons prices, verified 11 Aug. This is meant as the on-ramp: fewer meals, one shop, lower total spend, so cooking from the plan is a small commitment rather than a big one.

header.subLine: FD-5 · Week A · 10 meals over 4 days · What the starter shop cooks
header.hint: The plate side of the Morrisons starter shop — same 10 meals, same reasons the other 5 aren't here. Monday and Tuesday run in full; Wednesday is off completely; Thursday and Friday each keep two of three. Difficulty is tagged on every card — green cooks in under ten minutes with no real technique, orange wants your attention on the pan.

meals.name: Bodega egg & cheese
meals.method: Wilt the spinach in the pan, pour the beaten eggs over, fold into one soft slab and lay the cheese on top to melt under a lid. Folded into a warmed tortilla rather than a roll — same sandwich, a third of the starch. Tomato, black pepper, and enough hot sauce to make it count.

meals.name: Halal cart chicken over rice
meals.method: Sunday's chicken chopped and warmed through with oregano, cumin and turmeric. Underneath, rice cut half-and-half with cauliflower — riced, dry-fried, and honestly indistinguishable once the sauce is on. Chickpeas, shredded lettuce and tomato around the edge. White sauce: yoghurt, grated garlic, lemon, a great deal of black pepper.

meals.name: Chicken-crust pizza
meals.method: The base is the trick: chicken mince pressed thin with parmesan and egg, baked fifteen minutes at 220°C until it firms and browns. Passata over it, mozzarella, mushrooms, peppers, onion and spinach, then back in for eight. It carves like a pizza, lifts like a pizza, and does it without a gram of flour.

meals.name: Protein pancakes with berries
meals.method: Oats blitzed to flour with the whey, egg and half the skyr, then dropped in small rounds into a dry non-stick pan — small ones hold together, large ones do not. Stacked with the remaining skyr and a great heap of berries.

meals.name: Chipotle burrito bowl
meals.method: Sunday's chipotle beef over rice cut with cauliflower, with black beans, roast peppers and onion, sweetcorn, salsa, shredded lettuce and a restrained scoop of guacamole. Lime over the lot.

meals.name: Chicken katsu curry
meals.method: Chicken flattened thin, through beaten egg then panko, baked at 220°C for eighteen minutes and turned once — it crisps properly without a fryer. The sauce is onion and carrot cooked soft with curry powder and then blitzed smooth, which thickens it without flour. Rice cut with cauliflower, broccoli steamed.

cutCards: Wednesday's off entirely — egg sauce, efo riro and pepper soup all need plantain, and efo riro needs egusi too. Neither is stocked at Morrisons.

meals.name: Steak & egg breakfast sandwich
meals.method: Sirloin seasoned hard, seared two minutes a side and rested while the eggs fry in the same pan. Stacked on toasted seeded bread with wilted spinach and tomato. The bread is the low-carb seeded sort, which toasts far better than it has any right to.

meals.name: Smash burger with slaw
meals.method: Mince divided into two thin balls, pressed hard onto a screaming pan and left alone until the crust forms, then flipped with the cheese on. Seeded bun toasted in the fat. Lettuce, tomato, raw onion. Slaw of red cabbage, carrot and yoghurt alongside to keep it honest.

cutCards: Thursday's lunch (turkey bolognese with edamame spaghetti) is cut — Morrisons has no plain edamame or red-lentil pasta, and no turkey breast mince, only thigh.

meals.name: Chicken shawarma wrap
meals.method: Sunday's chicken tossed in shawarma spice and flashed in a hot dry pan. Cabbage, carrot and cucumber shredded with lemon. Rolled in a high-fibre tortilla with garlic yoghurt — one wrap, not two, because these are large and they are dense.

meals.name: Jerk salmon, rice & red beans
meals.method: Salmon rubbed with jerk paste and grilled ten to twelve minutes. Rice cooked with the kidney beans, thyme and a spoonful of coconut, then cauliflower stirred through at the end. Slaw of red cabbage and charred pineapple with lime, which is the part that makes the plate work.

cutCards: Friday's breakfast (callaloo & egg skillet) is cut — it needs plantain.

menu.readingNumbers: Kcal, protein, fat and net carb are per portion, already split by the two of you the way the whole plan is — his side runs bigger throughout. Spice is dots out of four, not a warning: the jerk salmon is the only thing here past two. Difficulty is genuinely about attention, not skill — the chicken-crust pizza takes the longest and needs a second bake, everything tagged green is a one-pan job under ten minutes.
